_comment: TfL Annex B display name -> the name the gazetteer resolves it by. Only for TfL wording that names a real place under a different spelling or form; the run still displays TfL's name. Every entry says why.

HARRINGAY GREENS LANES STATION N4.why: TfL typo. The Overground station on Green Lanes is Harringay Green Lanes (OSM railway=station name).

MYDDLETON SQUARE EC1.why: TfL typo. The Clerkenwell square is Myddelton Square (street signs, OSM highway name).

HONOUR OAK PARK SE23.why: TfL spelling. The SE23 road is Honor Oak Park (OSM highway name, Royal Mail).

THOMAS MOORE STREET E1.why: TfL typo. The Wapping street is Thomas More Street (OSM highway name).

LANDSDOWNE WAY SW8.why: TfL typo. The Stockwell road is Lansdowne Way (OSM highway name).

CONNINGHAM ROAD W12.why: TfL typo. The Shepherd's Bush road is Coningham Road (OSM highway name).

HIGH STREET NW10.why: NW10 has more than one High Street; the Anki export of the same run names this one Harlesden High Street.

HIGH STREET N8.why: The Anki export of the same run names this one Hornsey High Street (the N8 High Street).

WEST SIDE CLAPHAM COMMON SW4.why: Word order. OSM names the road Clapham Common West Side.

HANOVER GATE, REGENT'S PARK NW1.why: TfL qualifies the gate with its park; the point is Hanover Gate itself.

INNER CIRCLE, REGENT'S PARK NW1.why: TfL qualifies the road with its park; OSM names the road Inner Circle.

CHELSEA & WESTMINSTER HOSPITAL SW10.why: Ampersand. The curated override and OSM spell out 'and'.
